cases.scenario: Inspect the bound runtime and open a change confirmation without applying it.
expectations: Bound runtime and model are visible.
Changing runtime requires a confirmation; cancel keeps the binding.

cases.scenario: A missing runtime can be rescanned and proposed for explicit registration.
expectations: Rescan reveals a registration confirmation with explicit host login.

cases.scenario: An authentication failure for host login preserves the original task.
expectations: Host login has no isolated login action.
Only an explicit retry resumes the original task.

cases.scenario: An isolated login authentication failure offers login guidance and explicit retry.
expectations: An isolated login action is visible.
No login or retry is executed on mount.

cases.scenario: A missing runtime error offers rescan and settings while preserving the task.
expectations: Rescan is explicit; no alternate runtime is selected.

cases.scenario: A bound runtime's failed model inventory is visible and recoverable by rescan.
expectations: An error is shown instead of a fabricated model list.
Rescan restores the synthetic model list.

cases.scenario: Inspect the safe diagnostic summary and its source without exposing credentials.
cases.pendingReason: The diagnostic-summary feature is outside baseline a890891; integrate its reviewed source before adding a fixture.
expectations: Summary and failure kind match the Core receipt.
Credentials and private task content are absent.

cases.scenario: Create a synthetic group, select two colleagues and inspect their replies.
expectations: Two selected colleagues each reply once.
Group transcript and DM state remain separate.

cases.scenario: Inspect folded and expanded interjections within their original group turn.
cases.pendingReason: Interjection folding is outside baseline a890891; it must be verified after reviewed integration, not simulated as implemented.
expectations: Interjections start folded and expand without losing speaker or turn identity.
Toggling does not resend, change recipients or expose a DM.
